waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Omit to use the default credential WABA ID.

template_ids.description: Meta template IDs to report on.

anyOf.description: UNIX timestamp in seconds; Meta rounds it back to 00:00 UTC of that day.

start.description: Start of the reporting window. Defaults to 30 days before end. Meta keeps 90 days of history.

anyOf.description: UNIX timestamp in seconds; Meta rounds it back to 00:00 UTC of that day.

end.description: End of the reporting window. Defaults to today.

items.description: Template metric, such as COST, CLICKED, DELIVERED, READ, or SENT.

metric_types.description: Metrics to return. Omit for all. Conversion metrics such as APP_PURCHASES exist for Marketing Messages API businesses only.

product_type.description: Which product's template sends to report on. Omit for Cloud API.

use_waba_timezone.description: Whether daily windows follow the WABA's configured timezone instead of UTC. Timestamps passed as start or end are converted to YYYY-MM-DD, which Meta requires in this mode.

after.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous response.

description: Input for reading WhatsApp template analytics.
